events.notes: Computed from deduplicated flight_id records, filtering February by scheduled departure date in the origin airport's local time. Cancelled flights were excluded from both numerator and denominator; delays were actual minus scheduled and counted only when >15 minutes. AS records were converted from UTC using origin airport offsets, including local-date rollover.
